highlights.description: Terms carry IPA per locale beside their respellings, for TTS providers that accept phonemes

added.description: `Term.IPA` (`ipa` in JSON): BCP-47 locale → IPA pronunciation, used before the `pronunciations` respelling by providers that accept phonemes
`ExportIPAProfile()` — term → locale → IPA, the phoneme counterpart of `ExportPronunciationProfile()`, with aliases as keys

tests.description: `ExportIPAProfile()` with aliases and with terms without IPA

highlights.description: Canonical term IR for consistent handling of proper nouns, acronyms, and standard names across TTS, subtitles, and localization
247 embedded terms available as a Go dependency with no filesystem access

added.description: `Builtin()` — load ~237 embedded generic-industry terms for case-correction
`Curated()` — load ~10 hand-authored canonical terms with real pronunciation/translation data
`All()` — Builtin merged with Curated (Curated wins on ID collision)
`LoadDir()` and `LoadFS()` for loading terms from project directories or embedded filesystems
`ExportPronunciationProfile()` — term → locale → spoken form for TTS providers
`ExportCaseDictionary()` — lowercase alias → canonical form for subtitle correction
`ExportTranslationMap()` — canonical form → translated form for a given locale
`Merge()` and `Filter()` utilities for combining and selecting terms
JSON schema at `schema/terminology.schema.json` generated from Go types

documentation.description: README with installation, usage, term structure, translation policies, and consumer links

tests.description: Unit tests for `LoadDir`, `Merge`, `Filter`, and export functions
